profile.name: 数字输入输出模块
profile.description: 一种带有多路数字信号线的实验室数字输入/输出设备。各通道通常可配置为输入或输出，并以高/低电平方式工作，用于在实验系统中进行触发、同步、状态检测，以及控制开关、快门、继电器或其他数字逻辑设备。
profile.description_en: A laboratory digital input/output device with multiple digital lines. Each line can typically be configured as an input or output and operates with high/low logic levels. It is used for triggering, synchronization, state sensing, and control of switches, shutters, relays, or other digital logic hardware in experimental setups.
